title: Why you can't stop overthinking at 2am
description:
Why do intrusive thoughts show up the moment you lie down? Quiet, stress, and trying to push thoughts away can all keep your mind racing. A five-minute to-do list may help.

SOURCES
- Wegner, Schneider, Carter, White (1987), Paradoxical effects of thought suppression, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 53(1): 5-13
- Harvey (2002), A cognitive model of insomnia, Behaviour Research and Therapy 40(8): 869-893
- Schmidt et al. (2011), Cognitive and affective control in insomnia, Frontiers in Psychology
- Scullin et al. (2018), bedtime writing study, Journal of Experimental Psychology: General. Summary

Educational content, not medical advice. If sleep problems last, talk to a doctor.
